summary: The jenkins-pipelines skill carries all 64 guide rule ids with summaries that match the MUST text (CHK-3's deliberate rephrase is close-out P11), every link resolves in a fresh strict build, the plugin has a minor bump in the same commit, and Prettier is green. One advisory finding: the skill gives no guidance for the unconverted Jenkinsfiles it will meet before the migration.

findings.summary: The skill tells sessions every Jenkinsfile follows the guide and a breaking file is wrong, with no guidance for the unconverted files it fires on until the migration slice converts them
